description: Use this when the user wants to mail merge from Excel or CSV to PDF: personalized letters from a spreadsheet (thank-you letters for each donor, the same letter to 200 people with their names), certificates in bulk from a name list (award, completion, participation), or envelopes from a contact list (#10 with return address). Fills {{Field}} placeholders with defaults, formats and {{#if}} conditions for each row and returns ONE combined PDF (one document per record, up to 2,000 per batch) plus a per-record merge report CSV. Does not send email, mail, or print anything, and does not make mailing labels. Do not use for Outlook or Gmail bulk email.

address_template.description: Optional recipient address block (letters: inside address; envelopes: delivery address), one line per row, e.g. "{{First Name}} {{Last Name}}\n{{Street}}\n{{City}}, {{State}} {{ZIP}}". Defaults to one built from the name, company and address columns.

body_template.description: Certificates: the line under the name, may contain fields, e.g. "for completing {{Course}} ({{Hours}} hours) on {{Completed:date}}".

certificate_kind.description: Certificates: sets the default title and wording, e.g. completion -> "Certificate of Completion". Default achievement.

certificate_title.description: Certificates: custom title, e.g. "Certificate of Appreciation" or "Volunteer of the Year".

closing.description: Letters: closing line, e.g. "With gratitude,". Defaults to "Sincerely," unless the template already ends with a closing. Use "" for none.

csv_text.description: Alternative to a file: the list pasted as CSV or tab-separated text with a header row, e.g. "First Name,Last Name,City\nAna,Lopez,Austin".

date.description: Date printed on letters and certificates and used for {{today}}, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-03. Defaults to today (US Eastern time); pass the user's local date when known.

document_type.description: What to merge into: letter (US business letter, one per row), certificate (landscape award/completion/participation certificate, one per row), or envelope (#10 envelope with recipient and return address). Example: letter.

envelope_size.description: Envelopes: "10" for a #10 business envelope 4-1/8 x 9-1/2 in (default) or "a7" for a 5-1/4 x 7-1/4 in invitation envelope.

field_map.description: Optional explicit links from template fields to column names when names differ, e.g. {"Gift": "Donation Amount (USD)"}.

file.description: The spreadsheet with one row per recipient: Excel .xlsx, CSV or TSV, first row = column headers, e.g. donors.xlsx.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

has_header.description: Set false if the first row of the file is data, not column names (columns are then called Column A, Column B, ...). Default true.

include_address.description: Letters: print the recipient address block above the salutation. Default true when the sheet has address columns.

max_documents.description: How many records to put in this PDF (1-2000), e.g. 500. Default all, up to 2,000 per PDF.

missing_values.description: What to do when a record has an empty value for a field with no default: leave_blank (default), skip_record (leave that record out), or placeholder (print [Field Name] for proofreading).

names.description: Shortcut for a plain list of names (one column called Name), e.g. ["Ana Lopez", "Ben Okafor"]. Handy for certificates.

organization.description: Certificates: issuing organization printed at the top, e.g. Lincoln Elementary School.

presented_line.description: Certificates: the line above the name. Default "This certificate is proudly presented to" ("This certifies that" for completion).

recipient_template.description: Certificates: the name line, e.g. "{{First Name}} {{Last Name}}". Defaults to the Name column (or First + Last).

records.description: Alternative to a file: the recipients typed as objects with the same keys, e.g. [{"First Name": "Ana", "Last Name": "Lopez", "Amount": 250}].

sender.description: Letters: your name/organization and address at the top. Envelopes: the return address. One line per entry, e.g. ["Riverbend Animal Shelter", "120 Elm St", "Springfield, IL 62701"].

sheet.description: For an .xlsx file: the sheet (tab) name to use, e.g. Donors. Defaults to the first sheet that has data.

signature_name.description: Letters: name printed under the closing, e.g. Maria Chen.

signature_title.description: Letters: title under the signature name, e.g. Executive Director.

signers.description: Certificates: up to 3 signature lines, e.g. [{"name": "Alan Brooks", "title": "Principal"}].

name.description: Signer name, e.g. Dr. Alan Brooks.

start_record.description: For lists over 2,000 records: first record of this batch, e.g. 2001 for the second batch. Default 1.

style.description: Certificates: design style: classic (navy double border), gold (cream with gold seal), modern (teal geometric), deco (burgundy art deco). Default classic.

subject.description: Letters: optional subject line printed as "Re: ...", may contain fields, e.g. "Your {{Year}} giving statement".

template.description: Letters: the letter text from the salutation to the last paragraph, with merge fields, e.g. "Dear {{First Name|Friend}},\n\nThank you for your gift of {{Amount:currency}} on {{Gift Date:date}}.{{#if Company}} Please thank everyone at {{Company}}.{{/if}}". Syntax: {{Field}}, {{Field|default}}, {{Field:format}} with formats currency, number, integer, ordinal, date, short_date, iso_date, upper, lower, title, first_word, last_word; {{#if Field}}...{{else}}...{{/if}}, {{#if Field = value}}, {{#if Gift > 0}} (also !=, <, >=, <=; numbers or dates), {{#unless Field}}...{{/unless}}; {{today}} is the document date.

usps_style.description: Envelopes: print the delivery address in USPS style (uppercase, no periods or commas). Default false.

name: generate_merged_documents
title: Generate merged documents
